description: Reels explainer with voice-over and karaoke captions. Edit: rewrite one scene's voice-over.

brief.purpose: Explain compound interest in under 40 seconds

scenes.voText: Want your money to work while you sleep? Meet compound interest.
Each year you earn interest not just on what you saved, but on the interest you already earned.
Put one thousand dollars away at seven percent. In ten years it nearly doubles. In thirty, it's over seven times bigger.
So start early, add a little every month to something like an S&P index fund, and leave it alone.
Even ten dollars counts. Follow for part two.
